{{Quote|Battle droids?''"<br />"''It's an invasion army.|[[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref>}}
The '''Trade Federation Droid Army''', also referred to as the '''Federation Army''', was the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Army/Legends|army]] created and maintained by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] during the last decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. As the name suggested, it was made up of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]].

==History==
{{Quote|Soon you will have the politicians and bureaucrats eating out of your hands, and then the Trade Federation will at last have the droid army it needs. Baktoid, Haor Chall Engineering, and the Colicoids are waiting to fill your orders.''"<br />"''The army?''"<br />"''The riches of the Outer Rim await those with the courage to grab them. ''[&hellip;]'' It is your destiny. With a droid army to support you, who would dare question Neimoidia's authority to rule the space lanes?|Darth Sidious works to convince Nute Gunray to formally establish a Droid Army|<ref name="COD">''[[Cloak of Deception]]''</ref>}}
In the years following the [[Stark Hyperspace War/Legends|Stark Hyperspace War]], the Trade Federation became increasingly threatened by [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] and [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] attacks on outlying trade routes. This led to petitions to the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] to allow the Federation to arm its transport vessels to ward off such assaults. The armaments of the Federation were continually increased, but still its [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] overseers did not feel safe. In addition, [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation/Legends|Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]] had entered into a clandestine pact with [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], the result of which was the creation of a [[Trade Defense Force|military force]] for the Trade Federation.

[[File:Battle_Droid_Army.png|thumb|left|275px|[[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]] at the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of the Great Grass Plains]].]]
[[Baktoid Armor Workshop/Legends|Baktoid Armor Workshop]], [[Haor Chall Engineering/Legends|Haor Chall Engineering]], and the [[Colicoid Creation Nest/Legends|Colicoid Creation Nest]] were all contracted to produce battle droids and war machines for the Trade Federation, many of whose designs were based on existing technology used by the Federation. For instance, the [[Trade Federation ore barge]] was used as the basis for its [[C-9979 landing craft/Legends|C-9979 landing craft]], while the combat-ready form of the [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]] that would comprise the Federation's infantry force were updates of the pre-existing B1 [[Security droid/Legends|security droid]] design. Even Neimoidian designs had been incorporated, and the [[Droideka/Legends|droideka]] was made in the image of its [[Colicoid/Legends|Colicoid]] creators.

The earliest recorded assembly of the Trade Federation Army was in the hangar arm of the [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|battleship]] [[Acquisitor (Lucrehulk-class battleship)|''Acquisitor'']], prior to the [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]] [[Eriadu Trade Summit|Trade Summit]]. Here, representatives from Baktoid Armor and Haor Chall presented their designs to [[Viceroy/Legends|Viceroy]] Gunray and his aides. As well as landing craft and battle droids, [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Armored Assault Tanks]], [[Multi-Troop Transport/Legends|Multi-Troop Transports]], [[Platoon Attack Craft/Legends|Platoon Attack Craft]], and [[Single Trooper Aerial Platform/Legends|Single Trooper Aerial Platforms]] were displayed, though at this point, the Federation had not yet contacted the Colicoids.

This army was built up in secret, though B1 battle droids were revealed to [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] during the Eriadu Summit, when one was responsible for the deaths of members of the [[Trade Federation Directorate]]. The Army was first deployed during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], though tests were carried out in the [[Karthakk system]], where [[Nym/Legends|Nym]] and his [[Lok Revenants/Legends|Lok Revenants]] fought against droid forces on [[Lok/Legends|Lok]] and [[Eos]].

The Invasion of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] served as a turning point for the Federation. Their secret army was fully revealed, and used to subjugate [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] and other Naboo cities. However, this show of force soon turned sour when [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] rallied her followers in a desperate counterattack against the Naboo occupation. While the [[Gungan Grand Army/Legends|Gungan Grand Army]] [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|engaged]] the Droid Army on the [[Great Grass Plains/Legends|Great Grass Plains]], Amidala forced Nute Gunray to sign a treaty, effectively ending the occupation. To add insult to injury, the [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|Droid Control Ship]] in orbit was destroyed by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], rendering the entire army useless. The droids were loaded back onto their transports and removed from the system, while Gunray and his cohorts were sent to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] for trial.

The [[Supreme Court/Legends|Supreme Court]] decreed that the Droid Army be downsized, although Gunray himself was never convicted, and continued to fight for control of his army. Despite the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] mandate, the Federation managed to retain much of its armed forces. Further, the Federation began to not only rebuild but also improve its army in secret, utilizing droid factories on many worlds to greatly expand its military. When the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] was formed, the Trade Federation forces became part of the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]], fighting alongside droids from the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]], the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]], and other major corporate organizations.

==Composition==
{{Quote|Our security volunteers will be no match against the battle-hardened Federation Army.|[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Quarsh Panaka/Legends|Quarsh Panaka]]|<ref name="TPM" />}}
[[File:OOM_Battle_Droids.png|thumb|right|275px|An [[OOM command battle droid/Legends|OOM command battle droid]] and [[OOM-series security droid/Legends|OOM security battle droids]].]]
The true composition of the Trade Federation Droid Army remained unknown, due to its creation and deployment under a shroud of secrecy. Droid forces were hidden within the cavernous hangar bays of ''Lucrehulk''-class battleships and could be assembled from constituent parts that appeared innocuous enough to be overlooked by Republic customs officials. To invade worlds such as Lok and Naboo, the Federation loaded its droids into landing craft, which would make the trip from the Battleship to the planet's surface. From there, Multi-Troop Transports, [[C-9979 landing craft/Legends|Trade Federation dropships]], and [[Platoon Attack Craft/Legends|Platoon Attack Craft]] transported B1 battle droids from the landing zone directly into combat.

Prior to advancements made during the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]], the Droid Army was slaved to a [[Central Control Computer/Legends|Central Control Computer]], commonly held aboard a specialized Droid Control Ship situated in orbit above target worlds. Ground-based control computers were also deployed to broadcast backup signals. [[Core ship/Legends|Core ships]] could also dock in landing pits to broadcast such signals from the ground. Control Computers encrypted to command [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|''Vulture'' droid starfighters]] in control ships and battleships had an approximate operational range of sixteen thousand kilometers. The destruction of the Control Computer would cause all droid forces to shut down, and it was also known for control broadcasts to be intercepted or overwritten with enemy encryption, causing confusion in the Droid Army.

The invasion force launched against the city of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] consisted of thirty-three Multi-Troop Transports&mdash;each carrying one hundred and twelve battle droids&mdash;and three hundred and forty-two Armored Assault Tanks, as well as additional droid starfighters and infantry.

The Naboo invasion force included a wide variety of droids, including the [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|Beetle droid]], [[Energy pummel/Legends|Energy Pummel]], and [[Bio cannon|Bio Cannon]]. These forces were used against both the [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] and the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]].<ref name="Star Wars Galactic Battlegrounds">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''</ref>

==Organization==
The Droid Army, at least by the time of the Clone Wars as part of the Separatist Droid Army,<ref name="EGW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> was composed of nine levels in its command structure.

===Squad===
A '''squad''' consisted of eight battle droids. Because of their droid status, and thus being either directed remotely or otherwise programmed prior to an engagement, the squads never required an officer for the droid squads, although organic squads were led by a sergeant.<ref name="EGW" />

===Platoon===
A '''Platoon''' consisted of seven squads, and by extension, 56 battle droids.<ref name="EGW" />

===Company===
A '''Company''' consisted of two platoons, of which they were transported via either an [[Multi-Troop Transport/Legends|MTT]] or a [[Troop carrier/Legends|Troop carrier]]. As such, they were overall complemented by 112 battle droids, in addition to support droids. These were generally led by a battle droid officer, and were the lowest command chain for droid officers.<ref name="EGW" />

===Battalion===
A '''Battalion''' consisted of seven troop-carrier companies (either MTT or troop carriers), as well as a squadron of 24 [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|AATs]]. The overall droid count was at 784 battle droids, in addition to support droids, and were commanded by a battle droid officer.<ref name="EGW" />

===Vanguard===
'''Vanguards''' were designed to break through heavy defenses, and thus were primarily composed of 11 MTT companies and a squadron 18 AATs. As such there were 1,232 battle droids in addition to support droids, and were commanded by a battle droid officer.<ref name="EGW" />

===Regiment===
A '''Regiment''' consisted of four battalions and a single vanguard, composed of 4,368 battle droids as well as various support droids and commanded by a battle droid officer. In addition their numbers were the total force carried aboard one C-9979 landing craft.<ref name="EGW" />

===Division===
A '''Division''' consisted of five regiments, and were carried into battle via a section of five C-9979 landing craft. As such, they possessed a total of 21,840 battle droids in addition to support droids.<ref name="EGW" />

===Corps===
A '''Corps''' consisted of five divisions, and were carried into battle via a squadron of 25 C-9979 landing craft. As such, they possessed a total of 109,200 battle droids in addition to support droids.<ref name="EGW" />

===Army===
An '''Army''' consisted of two corps and represented the total surface force carried aboard a ''Luchrehulk''-class battleship. A single army was commanded by the battleship's captain, and was composed of 218,400 battle droids, as well as support droids.<ref name="EGW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Droid Army in the Battle of Grassy Plains was entirely computer-generated.
